provenance: Each observation is explicitly classified as PURE_XNA_DERIVED metadata or RUBY_MAPPING_QUALIFICATION; never CNA output
derivation: Foundation 42 Game timing and presentation properties. Contract rows are read from the pinned XNA 4.0 Windows metadata of Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Game.dll. Behaviour rows follow that assembly's IL: every one of the four getters is a single ldfld, so all four are managed fields the host loop reads rather than native queries; Game::.ctor sets isFixedTimeStep = true as a field initialiser, targetElapsedTime = TimeSpan.FromTicks(0x28b0b) = 166667 ticks and inactiveSleepTime = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(20) = 200000 ticks, and never assigns isMouseVisible, which therefore keeps the CLR default false. set_TargetElapsedTime throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the value is op_LessThanOrEqual TimeSpan.Zero, so zero is refused; set_InactiveSleepTime uses op_LessThan, so zero is accepted and only a negative duration is refused, despite its CLR resource being named InactiveSleepTimeCannotBeZero; set_IsFixedTimeStep and set_IsMouseVisible perform no validation at all.
